bio: Whether you prefer traditional Styrian cuisine or more sophisticated fare with a modern touch, this restaurant caters to your tastes. Almost exclusively regional ingredients are used in the set menu and à la carte dishes, eg char with kohlrabi, peas and vegetables and a truffle hollandaise sauce. The wine list with a focus on Austria is appealing, and the selection of wines by the glass is also good. You can opt for a table in the main dining area, in the bright winter garden or on the beautiful terrace. The restaurant is located in an art hotel, which has 10 individual guestrooms and a holiday apartment. Take a look around the garden with its sculptures by Peter Troißinger Sr – chef, sculptor and painter....
